acceptance: Each shipped Spark template key differs from the effective baseline, confirmed by the preflight capture on a live run.
Measured baseline vs tuned results (Spark version, scale factor, hardware) are recorded with the PR.
`--tuning tuned` on Spark resolves to the template, not the fallback, and the bundle records source `tuned` (ADR-002).
OBT claims, if any, come from the real rendered query set.
Template discovery tests pass for spark.
context: Origin: user-approved 2026-09-30; Opus finding C1. Requires live Spark and cannot be completed in a sandbox without it. Local PySpark 4.2.0 fails to start on this machine's JDK (ClassNotFoundException jdk.internal.ref.Cleaner), so use a supported JDK or a remote cluster.
description:
Today `--tuning tuned` on Spark resolves to TuningSource.FALLBACK (benchbox/cli/tuning_resolver.py ~L454) and runs identically to notuning. Add curated templates (benchbox/core/tuning/templates/spark/ and examples/tunings/spark/, per-benchmark such as tpch_tuned.yaml and tpcds_tuned.yaml, following the databricks/duckdb layout) so `tuned` means something.

Constraint from review: a template whose values already hold in a notuning run changes nothing and would be relabelled `tuned` (ADR-002). Every key in a shipped template must differ from the effective baseline established by spark-baseline-no-default-overrides and be confirmed by the preflight capture. Candidates (not decisions): shuffle partitions sized to scale factor, AQE coalesce/skew settings, broadcast threshold, CBO and join reorder (now tuned-only), codegen limits.

Measurement:
- Run on live Spark; record baseline vs tuned for TPC-H and TPC-DS at stated scale factors and Spark version. A template ships only if it demonstrates a measurable, explainable effect.
- OBT (TPC-DS One Big Table): prior probes used a synthetic 518-column table, not the real rendered queries. Do not cite them as OBT validation. Verified facts only: the OBT schema has 518 full / 424 minimal columns; the widest rendered projection is Q66 at 44 columns (sqlglot count over 89 queries). Test the actual rendered OBT queries and plans before making any codegen.maxFields or similar claim.
- Decide platform-wide vs benchmark-specific templates from the results (both layouts exist for other platforms).
